text.en:
Perk behavior changes depending on the <link enemy rank [#CombatantClassifications] /> of the target you're shooting.

Against Minor and Elite Combatants: 
Shots explode on hit, dealing up to 6.5 (32.5 on Shotgun) additional damage in a 3? meter radius. Explosions inherit the weapon's <link Combatant Damage Scaling [#CombatantScaling] />.

Trace Rifle-specific: only every 4th Hit explodes.

Against Minibosses and Bosses:
Exhausts for 5 seconds on hit.

Against Players:
Grants ?% Flinch Resistance for ? seconds.
